+from AlgorithmImports import *

+class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
+        self.symbols = {
+            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+            for ticker in self.tickers
+        }
+
+        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
+
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        # Quantities are tracked per strategy so each strategy manages only its
+        # own private lot.
+        self.strategy_a_quantity = 0
+        self.strategy_b_quantity = 0
+
+    def OnData(self, data):
+        bars = {}
+        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
+            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
+                bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]
+
+        spy_bar = bars.get("SPY")
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
+
+        aapl_bar = bars.get("AAPL")
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
+                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
+
+        all_bars_present = len(bars) == len(self.symbols)
+        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+
+        if all_bars_present and indicators_ready:
+            self._evaluate_strategy_a(spy_bar)
+            self._evaluate_strategy_b(aapl_bar)
+
+        # Preserve the immediately preceding trading day's values even on a
+        # day when another subscribed ticker is missing and trading is skipped.
+        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_a(self, bar):
+        if self.previous_spy_close is None or self.previous_spy_sma is None:
+            return
+
+        sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+        crosses_below = (
+            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+            and bar.Close < sma
+        )
+        crosses_above = (
+            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
+            and bar.Close > sma
+        )
+
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
+        if self.strategy_a_quantity > 0 and crosses_below:
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_quantity)
+            self.strategy_a_quantity = 0
+
+        if self.strategy_a_quantity == 0 and crosses_above:
+            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / bar.Close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
+                self.strategy_a_quantity = quantity
+
+    def _evaluate_strategy_b(self, bar):
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
+        if self.strategy_b_quantity > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_quantity)
+            self.strategy_b_quantity = 0
+
+        if self.strategy_b_quantity == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+            cash_to_invest = 20_000
+            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_to_invest:
+                quantity = int(cash_to_invest // bar.Close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
+                    self.strategy_b_quantity = quantity

+from AlgorithmImports import *

+class ParallelSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    """Two independent, close-driven strategy lots."""
+
+    SMA_PERIOD = 20
+    RSI_PERIOD = 14
+
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
+            self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders
+        )
+
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        # Warm up all state used by either strategy before permitting any trade.
+        self.SetWarmUp(max(self.SMA_PERIOD + 1, self.RSI_PERIOD + 1), Resolution.Daily)
+
+    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        # Market-state quantities continue to update from every available bar.
+        spy_bar = data.Bars[spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(spy) else None
+        aapl_bar = data.Bars[aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(aapl) else None
+
+        spy_crossed_above = False
+        spy_crossed_below = False
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
+            if (
+                self.spy_sma.IsReady
+                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
+                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
+            ):
+                spy_crossed_above = (
+                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
+                    and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+                )
+                spy_crossed_below = (
+                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+                    and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+                )
+            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
+                self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
+                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
+                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
+
+        # A missing bar for even an otherwise-unused subscription cancels all rules.
+        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+        if self.IsWarmingUp or not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
+            return
+
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys. Each counter records only its strategy lot.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
+            self.MarketOrder(spy, -self.spy_lot)
+            self.spy_lot = 0
+
+        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
+            self.MarketOrder(aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
+            self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
+            quantity = floor(
+                0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_bar.Close
+            )
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.MarketOrder(spy, quantity)
+                self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+            cash_to_invest = 20_000
+            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_to_invest:
+                quantity = floor(cash_to_invest / aapl_bar.Close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.MarketOrder(aapl, quantity)
+                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

+            self.RSI_PERIOD,

+        self.spy_previous_sma = None
+        self.aapl_previous_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

+        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
+
+        self.set_warm_up(self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.DAILY)

+        if any(symbol not in data.bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+

+        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.symbols["AAPL"]]
+        spy_close = spy_bar.close
+        aapl_close = aapl_bar.close
+
+        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
+            if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
+                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+            else:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.is_ready and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
+        comparisons_ready = (
+            self.spy_previous_close is not None
+            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
+            and self.aapl_previous_close is not None
+        )
+
+        if not self.is_warming_up and indicators_ready and comparisons_ready:

+                    self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma

+                )

+                        -self.strategy_a_shares,
+                        tag="Strategy A: close crossed below SMA",

+                    self.strategy_a_shares = 0
+
+            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
+                self.market_order(
+                    self.symbols["AAPL"],
+                    -self.strategy_b_shares,
+                    tag="Strategy B: RSI above 60",
+                )
+                self.strategy_b_shares = 0
+
+            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
+                crossed_above = (
+                    self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
+                    and spy_close > spy_sma
+                )
+                if crossed_above:
+                    quantity = self.calculate_order_quantity(
+                        self.symbols["SPY"], 0.40
+                    )
+                    if quantity > 0:
+                        self.market_order(
+                            self.symbols["SPY"],
+                            quantity,
+                            tag="Strategy A: close crossed above SMA",
+                        )
+                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity
+
+            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+                if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
+                    quantity = floor(20_000 / aapl_close)
+                    if quantity > 0:
+                        self.market_order(
+                            self.symbols["AAPL"],
+                            quantity,
+                            tag="Strategy B: three red days",
+                        )
+                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity
+
+        self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
+        if self.spy_sma.is_ready:
+            self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
+        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
